by
  let σ : F.obj X ≅ F.obj Y := CategoryTheory.NatIso.ofComponents.app F F (λ _ => id) (λ _ _ => rfl) i.is_iso
  have h : σ.app X = σ.app Y ∘ F.map i := by rw [NatIso.ofComponents.app_app, NatIso.ofComponents.app_app, NatIso.ofComponents.naturality, id_comp]
  let f := σ.hom
  let g := σ.inv
  let hf : Function.Bijective f := by intros x y; exact Eq.symm (Function.injective_iff_surjective (Function.bijective_iff_left_inverse f g))
  let hg : Function.Bijective g := by intros x y; exact Eq.symm (Function.injective_iff_surjective (Function.bijective_iff_left_inverse g f))
  exact Nat.subtype_card (f) (Finset.card_eq_of_bijection f g)
